text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's finally my first battle with Taiki! 
She told me, "I wish we could've raced 
when you were feeling better," but it's 
actually the exact opposite!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Struggling through that hard luck opened 
up new possibilities! Now, let's see if 
this running can take on the world—time 
for a test!
